revision: per GameSessionId, strictly above any revision the session has seen, across reconnect, resume and transfer (the NPC-0 pattern); every admission, reconnect, resume and transfer starts with a snapshot of the open rooms; lines are never replayed from storage; capability 36 selects snapshot type 2 instead of 1, carrying the current guild/motd view; same revision stream; capability 80 adds delta type 3, the channel list, sent after a request or a change and never from storage; capability 233 adds transient delta type 4, carrying a visible player's typing state; it uses the same revision stream and is never restored from storage; capability 258 adds delta type 5 for expiring VIP presence, using this same revision stream; WU26 capabilities 493 (private echo, line field 12), 495 (line kind 8 channel notices) and 496 (line field 13 line_sequence, the delta's own new revision) extend delta type 1 to at most 1280 bytes, and 494 (list field 4) and 495 (list field 5) extend delta type 3 to at most 37500 bytes; without them every payload keeps its earlier bound and bytes
